_about: The ONE golden pin for the first-week clause (Q-7601 fix round). Inputs are the shapes the 2026-11-16 staging probe captured as a Free v2 org (keel_plan_usage at the start, keel_backtest_run notices at 37 and 18 left, the wall at 75 of 75). Every other first-week test computes its expectation from its own data; this file pins the exact words. tests/test_plan_limits_first_week_golden.py reads it.
